payload.thirtySeconds: MattF steals the net trophy at +5 while KeithK75 wins gross at +4 and still somehow leaves everyone else in the mud. Keith was the cleanest ball-striker in the field, but Matt’s tee-to-green pop and putting were the louder chaos engine on a course that happily punished every bad decision.
payload.latestTournamentTeaser: MattF nabs net as KeithK75 cooks the ball-striking
payload.stateOfLeague: KeithK75 keeps acting like the class of the room in gross, but MattF just put together the kind of balanced round that can crash the party. Tobacco Road also reminded everybody that the bottom can get real ugly fast when the tee ball and short game both go on a bender.
